pass_a_gloss: First brother spokesman; fried yet exhorting; God's eye and the agonothetes.
pass_b_english: After Eleazar, the seven brethren with their mother. The first, spokesman, said: 'What wilt thou ask and learn from us? We are ready to die rather than transgress our fathers' (2 Maccabees 7:2–6) laws.' Set in the pan and fried, yet breathing, he exhorted the rest to look to God's all-seeing eye and to the president of the contest, who strengthens the willing, and died praying them to manful endurance.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Exhortatio exists; nothing to compare.
